newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall 2.20 pct on rates concerns.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall 2.20 pct on rates concerns.

text.p: Thai stocks dropped 2.20 percent at 0919 GMT as investors unloaded stocks and took profits on worries that commercial banks may not cut their rates soon, brokers said.
"Investors sold as they were not sure whether banks would cut their interest rates or not," said one broker.
The composite SET index slipped further and was at 582.62, down 13.57 points or 2.28 percent, at 0926 GMT.
